subject: general
question: Who among the following assumed charge as Officer on Special Duty (Defence Secretary-designate) on August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajesh Kumar Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rajesh Kumar Singh was appointed as the Officer on Special Duty (Defence Secretary-designate) on August 2024.
 
• He is expected to take over as the Defence Secretary, a key position in the Ministry of Defence, overseeing the country's defence policies and administration.
 
• Rajesh Kumar Singh has previously held various significant roles within the government, contributing to his extensive experience in public administration.
 
• His appointment is part of a regular process of filling top positions within the Indian bureaucracy, ensuring experienced leadership in crucial ministries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defence Secretary**

 
 
• The Defence Secretary is a top official within the Ministry of Defence, responsible for the formulation and implementation of defence policies.
 
• The role includes overseeing the defence budget, procurement, and coordination among the three armed services - Army, Navy, and Air Force.
 
• The Defence Secretary is pivotal in ensuring national security and managing international defence cooperation.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Defence**
 
 
• The Ministry of Defence is charged with coordinating and supervising all agencies and functions of the government relating to national security and the armed forces.
 
• It is one of the key ministries in the Indian government, playing a critical role in maintaining the country's defence readiness and strategic interests.
 
• The ministry is headed by the Defence Minister, a cabinet-level position.
 
 
 
• **Indian Bureaucracy**
 
 
• The Indian bureaucracy is an essential part of the government machinery, ensuring the implementation of policies and administration of public services.
 
• It comprises various civil services, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Foreign Service (IFS), and Indian Police Service (IPS).
 
• Bureaucrats play a key role in policy formulation, public administration, and governance.
 
 
 
• **Public Administration**
 
 
• Public administration involves the implementation of government policies and the management of public programs.
 
• It is essential for maintaining order, delivering public services, and ensuring the effective functioning of the government.
 
• Professionals in public administration work across various levels of government to improve societal outcomes.
